en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning extended until midnight Tuesday
en.dek: The Observatory prolonged the warning first issued at 6.30pm Monday, saying isolated thunderstorms are still expected over Hong Kong.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory extended the Thunderstorm Warning until midnight on Tuesday after first issuing it at 6.30pm on Monday.

Isolated thunderstorms are expected to affect Hong Kong. Members of the public are advised to seek shelter if outdoors, stay away from water and high ground, and keep clear of conductive objects, trees or masts when thunderstorms occur.
The warning was last updated at 10pm on Monday.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告延長至周二午夜
zh.dek: 天文台周一傍晚6時30分發出的雷暴警告延長有效至周二午夜12時，預料本港仍有局部地區雷暴。
body: 天文台將周一傍晚6時30分發出的雷暴警告延長至周二午夜12時，預料香港有局部地區雷暴。
雷暴發生時，市民應到安全地方躲避，離開水面，切勿站立高地或接近導電物體、樹木或桅杆。
警告於周一晚上10時更新。
